ocr.notes: Most of the text readable but several garbled passages, including parts of the Allen fight section and the 'other ring fights' answer.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reprinted a New York World interview with Ben Hogan, now a reformed drinker and gambler, who said his match with Tom Allen was made in St. Louis and that their fight came out a draw.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Monday Morning, November 4, 1878, page 2. Reprinted from the New York World.

facts.fact: Ben Hogan said he met Allen in St. Louis on his way to Hot Springs and put up the money for a match with him there
Ben Hogan later claimed his fight with Allen came out a draw

notes: Interview is mostly about Hogan's conversion and life; Allen is one section. Hogan's draw claim conflicts with other reports that Allen won. Fight year not stated in the article.
